title: Morrow personal audio introduction
audience: Design-conscious listeners who want calmer music discovery
scenario: Morrow is a new listening app organized around daily rituals rather than engagement feeds.
task: Build an expressive product introduction that communicates the ritual concept and encourages visitors to join the early-access list.

content.primary_heading: Music for the shape of your day
sections: Minimal navigation with Rituals, Artists, Journal, and Join early access
Hero with the primary heading, a calm discovery statement, and Join early access
Three rituals named First Light, Deep Work, and Night Window
Product principle section titled Less feed, more feeling
Artist note featuring Nia Vale and the release Glass Hours
Early-access email form with a concise privacy note
Footer with Journal, Instagram, Privacy, and Contact

requirements: Give each ritual a time-of-day cue and a one-sentence listening description
Use a properly labeled email field and explicit submit control
Ensure the artist feature is content, not unexplained decoration
Respect reduced-motion preferences if motion is declared
Preserve heading and reading order at narrow widths
constraints: Do not implement audio playback or imply that previews function
Do not use remote album art, fonts, or services
Do not add pricing or fabricated listener counts
Avoid generic feature-card copy such as fast, powerful, or seamless
evaluation_focus: Distinctive product voice encoded in concrete content
Accessible email acquisition and honest static behavior
Coherent sequencing of ritual, principle, and artist story
